<documents>
<document id="docs-account-details">
FindingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆYourˆroutingˆnumberˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails.ˆYou'llˆneedˆthemˆforˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆtoˆlinkˆTallowbrookˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆorˆtoˆreceiveˆaˆwire.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆfindˆthemˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆAccountˆdetails.ˆTapˆtheˆeyeˆiconˆtoˆshowˆtheˆfullˆaccountˆnumber.ˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆit'sˆyouˆfirst.ˆ##ˆCardˆnumberˆversusˆaccountˆnumberˆYourˆcardˆnumberˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆnumber.ˆDon'tˆgiveˆyourˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆanˆemployerˆforˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆthemˆsafeˆOnlyˆgiveˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆtoˆpeopleˆandˆcompaniesˆyouˆtrust,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployer.ˆSomeoneˆwithˆtheseˆnumbersˆcanˆtryˆtoˆpullˆmoneyˆbyˆACH.ˆIfˆthatˆhappens,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆSupportˆwon'tˆreadˆthemˆoutˆForˆsecurity,ˆsupportˆwon'tˆreadˆyourˆfullˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆyouˆinˆchatˆorˆonˆtheˆphone.ˆYouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆthemˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWireˆinstructionsˆForˆincomingˆwires,ˆuseˆtheˆWireˆinstructionsˆscreenˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆwhichˆalsoˆshowsˆourˆSWIFTˆcodeˆforˆinternationalˆwires.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-metal">
TheˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆPremiumˆmembersˆgetˆaˆmetalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆworksˆexactlyˆlikeˆtheˆplasticˆcard,ˆwithˆtheˆsameˆnumber,ˆlimitsˆandˆcontrols.ˆ##ˆGettingˆyourˆmetalˆcardˆWhenˆyouˆupgradeˆtoˆPremium,ˆtheˆappˆasksˆwhetherˆyouˆwantˆaˆmetalˆcardˆnowˆorˆatˆyourˆnextˆrenewal.ˆIfˆyouˆorderˆitˆnow,ˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆmetalˆone.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆitˆReplacementsˆforˆaˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamagedˆmetalˆcardˆareˆmetalˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆisˆfreeˆonˆPremiumˆtoo,ˆandˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆleaveˆPremiumˆYourˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆorˆifˆyouˆneedˆaˆreplacement,ˆyou'llˆgetˆaˆplasticˆcard.ˆ##ˆDisposalˆMetalˆcardsˆcan'tˆbeˆcutˆwithˆscissors.ˆWhenˆyouˆreplaceˆone,ˆyouˆcanˆmailˆitˆbackˆtoˆusˆinˆtheˆprepaidˆenvelopeˆthatˆcomesˆwithˆtheˆnewˆcard,ˆandˆwe'llˆrecycleˆit.ˆContactlessˆworksˆonˆmetalˆcardsˆtheˆsameˆwayˆitˆdoesˆonˆplastic.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="check-deposit-how">
DepositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆappˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆdepositˆ1.ˆSignˆtheˆbackˆofˆtheˆcheck.ˆ2.ˆUnderˆyourˆsignature,ˆwriteˆ"ForˆmobileˆdepositˆonlyˆatˆTallowbrook".ˆ3.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆDepositˆaˆcheck.ˆ4.ˆEnterˆtheˆamountˆandˆphotographˆtheˆfrontˆandˆbackˆonˆaˆdarkˆsurface.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆmobileˆcheckˆdepositˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆKeepˆtheˆcheckˆKeepˆtheˆpaperˆcheckˆforˆ14ˆdaysˆafterˆit'sˆdeposited,ˆthenˆdestroyˆit.ˆDon'tˆdepositˆtheˆsameˆcheckˆanywhereˆelse.ˆ##ˆChecksˆweˆcan'tˆacceptˆChecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆsomeoneˆelse,ˆchecksˆfromˆoutsideˆtheˆUS,ˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆchecksˆwithoutˆtheˆendorsementˆabove.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆisˆavailableˆSeeˆ"Whenˆcheckˆdepositsˆareˆavailable".ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆreleaseˆdateˆafterˆyouˆsubmitˆtheˆdeposit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
